messages:
maria-marketing: Quick heads up — we got a note from growth that a handful of MQLs (enterprise size) didn't land with SDRs this morning. Looks like HubSpot enrichment step timed out and the round-robin didn't kick in. Can someone triage?

aj-salesops: On it. Which workflow ID?

maria-marketing: workflow: HBSP->inbound-routing (id 9876). Observed at ~08:14 UTC. Affected leads show `company_size > 1000` and `industry: fintech` — should route to enterprise SDR pool.

kevin-sdr: saw 3 leads drop in my inbox yesterday afternoon but no assignments today. I assumed they were duplicates.

sam-eng: I can pull logs from the enrichment lambda and the webhook that writes to HubSpot. Will check for 5xxs or rate limits.

aj-salesops: FYI we recently changed the round-robin to use `owner_pool = enterprise-sdr-v2`. I rolled that out last week but added a fallback to `enterprise-sdr` that might not be firing.

maria-marketing: The immediate ask from growth: ensure SLA for initial SDR touch is documented (30m for enterprise hot, 4h for warm) and that escalation to AEs happens automatically after 4h if unclaimed.

lina-gm: +1 on SLAs. Also want audit trail of enrichment (clear timestamps) so CS can trust the handoff.

sam-eng: Found errors in enrichment service at 08:13: `TimeoutError: enrichment lookup exceeded 3s`. HubSpot webhook received the lead without enrichment fields, and our workflow has a condition `has_enriched_company = true` — so it skipped assignment.

aj-salesops: That explains it. Quick patch options: 1) relax workflow to assign on raw leads then patch enrichment fields later, 2) add synchronous retry of enrichment, 3) add fallback round-robin when enrichment missing. Which do we want for now?

maria-marketing: Option 3 seems safest short-term — we want no leads left unassigned. Then we can follow up with a better retry strategy.

kevin-sdr: Option 3 works. If we get low-quality leads assigned, we can tag them and route to the intake queue.

aj-salesops: I'll flip the workflow rule to `assign if has_enriched_company OR lead_age < 5m` and enable fallback owner_pool. Pushing change in 10m.

ops-bot: Deploy started for hubspot/workflows/9876 by aj-salesops at 2025-07-02T08:45:00Z

sam-eng: Also added a 2-retry backoff in enrichment lambda (500ms -> 1s) and a circuit breaker log so we can detect repeated failures.

aj-salesops: Patch applied and tested with a synthetic lead. Round-robin now assigns to enterprise-sdr-v2 then enterprise-sdr fallback.

kevin-sdr: Received test lead, assigned to me via enterprise-sdr-v2. :thumbsup:

maria-marketing: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) update playbook with SLA values and the new workflow behavior, 2) add a daily monitor that alerts if >1% of leads hit fallback in 24h.

lina-gm: Also add an escalation rule to ping on-call AE after 4h unclaimed with lead metadata and enrichment status.

aj-salesops: Noted. I'll update the HubSpot workflow notes and add the Prometheus alert target (alert:HubSpotFallbackRate > 1%).

sam-eng: I'll wire a small trace event `lead_assignment_status` with values [assigned_with_enrichment, assigned_without_enrichment, fallback_assigned, unassigned] to help metrics.

maria-marketing: Perfect. I'll file the handoff SLA doc and link it in the playbook. Adding owners: aj-salesops for workflow, sam-eng for enrichment fixes/metrics, kevin-sdr for SDR feedback loop.

ops-bot: Workflow 9876 deployment completed successfully by aj-salesops at 2025-07-02T08:52:47Z

maria-marketing: Thanks everyone. I'll ping growth with the fix and update the playbook. /cc @lina-gm :rocket:
